Hi Dylan and Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last month — the team found the latency/cost controls compelling. We
would like to schedule a two-day enablement retreat the week of Oct 16 to accelerate our SI &
customer-facing teams on Redwood’s runtime and partner playbook. High-level asks:

- 60–90m keynote on Redwood deployment modes and routing policies
- 90m hands-on lab (model serving + KV caching configuration)
- Breakout sessions for sales/solutions and engineering integration patterns
- A short mutual action plan template we can use post-retreat

We’ve got about 18 attendees (mix of pre-sales, solutions architects, and infra engineers).
I attached a short partner brief with our goals.

lead the labs.

Thanks,

Hi Samantha — great to hear from you and thanks for the brief.

We can run the retreat the week of Oct 16; preliminary availability: Oct 17–18. We can host the
hands-on lab and will bring a Solutions Engineer + two infra engineers to run the lab stations.

Proposed scope for our side (we’ll finalize once we get your attendee roles):
- Day 1 morning: Overview + deployment patterns (hosted vs dedicated vs private) — 60m
- Day 1 afternoon: Integration patterns & partner playbook for SIs — 90m
- Day 2 morning: Hands-on lab (model serving, KV prefix caching, autoscaling policies) — 120m
- Day 2 afternoon: MOSA (mutual action plan) workshop and next steps — 60m

I’m attaching a draft itinerary (proposed-itinerary.xlsx). Can you send a quick attendee list and
let us know which teams need deep infra lab seats?

Also copying Marissa and Sean — Marissa will lead the SI enablement curriculum; Sean will scope the
hands-on lab.

Best,

Partner Solutions | Redwood Inference
